title: YesStyle Black Friday 2026: has it started? This week's coupon, dates and where CECILIA010 goes

description: YesStyle's Black Friday is already on, with the Mega Sale and a tiered coupon of 8% to 15% this week. See where the CECILIA010 Reward Code goes and when the 15% days arrive.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, YesStyle does Black Friday, and it is already on: the home page has the Mega Sale, with per-product deals and banners up to 50% off, and this week's tiered coupon gives 8%, 10% or 15%. CECILIA010 stacks with it, in the Reward Code field. The 15% no-minimum days are the part still to come.

contentSections.heading: When YesStyle's Black Friday starts
paragraphs: YesStyle publishes the rules of each coupon in the site's help center, with the start and end day and time. The table below has the 2025 dates; in 2024, the phases followed the same order and started a day or two later. In 2026 the campaign has already started: on November 3, the store's home page shows the "Black Friday Mega Sale", with per-product deals and banners up to 50% off, and this week's tiered coupon (8% over US$ 79, 10% over US$ 149 and 15% over US$ 199), which the store swaps every few days. Standard shipping is free over US$ 35. The end date and the 15% no-minimum days for 2026 are not out yet.

comparisonTable.caption: Coupons open to all members in 2025, from YesStyle's help pages; each phase runs until the next one begins. Dates are in GMT, which is what counts for the store.

postParagraphs: In 2026, Black Friday falls on November 27 and Cyber Monday on November 30. If YesStyle repeats the pattern, the 15% days with no minimum should land around those two dates. This is an estimate based on past years: the store can change everything, and this guide is updated when the 2026 pages come out.
Coupons switch at a fixed time in GMT. In 2025, the tiered coupons switched at 2:00 GMT, and the 15% with no minimum started at 8:00 GMT.

contentSections.heading: The Black Friday coupon is the same as the rest of the year

image.alt: Cecília Mauad smiling with the boxes of the Abib products she received from YesStyle, in a frame from the Korean skincare routine video

paragraphs: The October 2025 tiered coupon (Mid-Season Sale) had exactly the same tiers as the November Black Friday coupon. It is the discount YesStyle runs almost all year, changing the name and the code every few days. This week's code is on the [YesStyle coupons and Reward Code](/en/coupons/yesstyle) page, because the store swaps it within days.

comparisonTable.caption: Tiers of YesStyle's tiered coupon in 2024 and 2025, the same outside and inside Black Friday. The discount applies to the price of the products.

postParagraphs: The days with no minimum have the same 15% cap. What they do is open that percentage to any cart.

contentSections.heading: Is it worth waiting for the 15% days with no minimum?
paragraphs: It depends on the size of your cart:

image.alt: Step chart of the discount by order value at YesStyle: 0% up to US$ 79, 8% from US$ 79, 10% from US$ 149 and 15% from US$ 199, with a dashed line at 15% from US$ 0
image.caption: The green line is the tiered coupon: 8% from US$ 79, 10% from US$ 149 and 15% from US$ 199. The dashed line shows the 15% days with no minimum. Illustration by Em Casa com Cecília.

bullets: **Cart of US$ 199 or more:** the tiered coupon already gives 15% on any day, the same percentage as the no-minimum days. What can change around Friday is the promotional price of each product, not the coupon.
**Cart between US$ 79 and US$ 199:** the tiered coupon gives 8% or 10%. On the no-minimum days, the same cart gets 15%.
**Cart under US$ 79:** the tiered coupon gives nothing. These are the carts that gain most by waiting for the 15% days with no minimum.

contentSections.heading: How to stack CECILIA010 with the Black Friday coupon
paragraphs: YesStyle's checkout has two fields. The coupon of the day goes in Coupon Code. CECILIA010 goes in Reward Code. The rules of all the Black Friday coupons from 2024 and 2025 say they are valid together with promotional prices, with Reward Codes and with YS Points, the store's own points.

image.alt: YesStyle checkout Enter Code window, with a coupon in the Coupon field and CECILIA010 in the Influencer/Reward Code field
image.caption: The two checkout fields: the day's coupon on top and CECILIA010 in the Reward Code field.

bullets: Log in to your account before you build the cart: the coupons are for members only.
Build your cart and check that it reaches the tier you want (US$ 79, 149 or 199).
Paste the coupon of the day into the Coupon Code field.
Paste CECILIA010 into the Reward Code field: 5% on your first order and 2% on later ones.
Check both discounts in the order summary before you pay.

contentSections.heading: The rules that trip people up most on Black Friday
bullets: **Members only:** if you check out as a guest, you cannot use the coupon. Create your account before the day of the promotion.
**One coupon per order:** you cannot combine two YesStyle coupons in the same order. The Reward Code is left out of that count, because it goes in another field.
**Product prices only:** the coupon does not discount shipping or other fees.
**Some products are excluded:** the product page and the checkout tell you when the coupon does not apply to it.
**The time that counts is the store's:** what matters is the time YesStyle's system records the order, in GMT. An order placed after the coupon ends gets no discount.
**You can use it more than once:** during the promotion, the same coupon is valid on as many orders as you place.

contentSections.heading: Offers that are not for everyone
paragraphs: In 2025, besides the coupon open to all members, YesStyle had two restricted offers. During Black Friday week, the Bronze, Silver and Gold levels of the Elite Club, the store's loyalty program, had one product a day for US$ 1, on orders from US$ 50. One per order, while stock lasted, with no exchange or return. And between Black Friday and Cyber Monday, an 18% coupon with no minimum went to selected members ("We Miss You"). The page does not explain how those members were chosen.
If one of those coupons shows up in your account, the rule is the same: it stacks with the Reward Code and with YS Points.

contentSections.heading: After Black Friday: Christmas
paragraphs: In 2024, the biggest end-of-year coupon was not the Black Friday one: in Christmas week, YesStyle gave 18% with no minimum on everything. In 2025, the coupons open to all members stayed at 15% until the end of the year.
For Christmas gifts, the Black Friday purchase is the safest. An international order takes longer than one from a local store, and the estimated delivery time appears at checkout before you pay.

contentSections.heading: Delivery and taxes
paragraphs: Shipping and delivery time appear at checkout, and the coupon does not discount shipping. If the package is taxed on arrival, YesStyle refunds the taxes and customs fees on orders under US$ 1,000, as store credit. What the store publishes about delivery and how to ask for the refund is in the [YesStyle delivery guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: A cart idea: the Abib routine
paragraphs: In the video at the end of this article, Cecília tests three products from the Korean brand Abib that she received from YesStyle: the hydrogel eye patch, the booster cream with PDRN and the lip mask. It is a short routine for anyone starting out in Korean skincare, and a good starting point for building your Black Friday cart.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does YesStyle's Black Friday start and how long does it last? It has already started: the store's home page has the Black Friday Mega Sale and this week's tiered coupon. YesStyle has not published the end yet; in 2024 and 2025, the coupons named Black Friday ran until Cyber Monday.
What is the YesStyle coupon on Black Friday? It changes every few days. The YesStyle page here on the site shows this week's code, with the date it was checked.

Does the YesStyle Black Friday coupon have a minimum order value? The tiered coupon does: 8% from US$ 79, 10% from US$ 149 and 15% from US$ 199. On the days around Friday and Cyber Monday, YesStyle usually opens 15% with no minimum.

Is it better to buy on Black Friday or Cyber Monday at YesStyle? In 2024 and 2025, both had 15% with no minimum, so the coupon cap was the same. What changes from one day to the next is the promotional price of each product.
Does YesStyle have promotions outside Black Friday? Yes. The tiered coupon, with 8%, 10% and 15%, runs almost all year and changes its name every few days.
Does CECILIA010 work on Black Friday? Yes. It goes in the Reward Code field, and the Black Friday coupon rules say the coupons are valid together with Reward Codes.
Can I use two YesStyle coupons on the same order? No: it is one coupon per order. The Reward Code is a different thing and goes in another checkout field.
Do I need a YesStyle account to use the Black Friday coupon? Yes. The coupons are for members only, and guest checkouts get no discount.

Will I pay tax when buying from YesStyle? There may be a charge when the package arrives. On orders under US$ 1,000, YesStyle refunds those taxes as store credit, if you send the receipt within 30 days.
